decisions.reason: The organic poultry mini salami snack is cheap to maintain on existing curing lines and fits the organic expansion, but after two years with no visible signs of traction in a niche snack format, the delisting risk is rising, so it is kept for one more period while retail results resolve.

The premium sharing salami line uses established processes at low holding cost, and there is still no clear negative signal, so the option is kept open, though Product A's withdrawal shows that two-year-old salami formats are being reviewed.

The organic Fleischwurst was launched only in 2024, is promoted as a new member of the organic range, and builds on core boiled-sausage know-how, so its uncertainty is high and keeping it costs little.

The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line in two variants is a fresh 2024 launch in a growing ingredient-conscious poultry segment, so the option should stay open until sales evidence accumulates.

The organic herb-coated salami is a low-cost variant on existing maturation capabilities with only one year on the market, so there is not yet enough evidence to abandon it, though it partly overlaps with the withdrawn organic salami platter.
